import pixeltable as pxt
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer

# Initialize pixeltable
pxt.create_client()

# Get the docs table
docs = pxt.get_table('docs')

# Create embedding UDF using sentence-transformers
@pxt.udf
def embed_text(text: str):
    model = SentenceTransformer('all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
    return model.encode(text)

# Create embeddings column
docs['embeddings'] = docs['content'].apply(embed_text)

# Create vector index for nearest-neighbor search
docs.create_index('embeddings', index_type='vector')

# Prepare query embedding
model = SentenceTransformer('all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
query_embedding = model.encode('climate change policy')

# Perform semantic search - return 5 closest rows ranked by distance
results = docs.select(
    docs['content'],
    docs['embeddings'].distance(query_embedding).alias('distance')
).order_by('distance', ascending=True).limit(5)

# Display results
print(results.to_pandas())
